prompts.appbar:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE polished educational raster image for Korean non-developers learning the UI component "상단 바" (top app bar). This will be a website example thumbnail with a larger detail view. Landscape 3:2 composition, flat straight-on realistic web application screenshot, large crisp Korean typography, white surfaces, pale slate background, dark navy text, royal blue controls, restrained rounded corners, subtle shadows. No device frame, no browser chrome, no watermark, no abstract wireframes or empty skeleton blocks.
Show a fictional Korean class-booking application. At the very top of its screen, one horizontal app bar contains a small simple blue logo and "클래스", navigation "둘러보기" and "내 예약", and a small circular account avatar at the far right. Below it, show a clear page title "새로운 배움을 찾아보세요" and two realistic class cards containing natural photos of pottery and cooking with short labels "도자기 만들기" and "쿠킹 클래스". This surrounding content provides context but should be less prominent.
The TEACHING TARGET is ONLY the full horizontal top app bar. Emphasize that full bar with ONE warm orange rectangular outline, 5px thick, and a faint warm tinted background. The outline should be inside the image and tightly surround the top bar, not the entire page. No arrows, no caption outside the app, no extra floating panels. UI must look plausible and functional. Keep text few and legible. Leave safe padding around the whole screenshot.
